title: Heart Rate Variability & Autonomic Modulation
author: Dr. Andrew Huberman / Lab Protocols
summary: HRV rMSSD reflects vagal nerve tone and the balance between sympathetic mobilization and parasympathetic recovery. A sudden drop signals incomplete systemic recovery.
takeaway: When recovery is Yellow (<50%), substitute high-intensity intervals at Crunch Fitness with Zone 2 aerobic base and reduce heavy academic problem sets.

title: Deep Work: Rules for Focused Success in a Distracted World
author: Cal Newport
summary: Attention residue accumulates rapidly with frequent task switching. High-cognitive work requires insulated 20-to-50 minute time blocks without intermediate inbox checks.
takeaway: Enforce the morning 06:30 pre-work focus window and 12:30 micro-learning sprint with browser notifications strictly blocked.

title: Why We Sleep: Unlocking the Power of Sleep and Dreams
author: Dr. Matthew Walker
summary: NREM Slow-Wave Sleep (SWS) mediates physical tissue and endocrine restoration, while REM consolidates memory, complex schema, and new learning acquired during study sprints.
takeaway: Prioritize the 21:00 evening decompression (box breathing and spinal release) to initiate core body temperature drops and parasympathetic tone before bed.
